repair_proposal.repair_name: Activate Compatibility Trigger Before Backfill & Dual-Write Trigger
repair_proposal.explanation: The violation occurred because the backfill process ran before the compatibility trigger was active. Consequently, any legacy payment events processed during the backfill window updated the legacy table without updating the new status_id column, leading to a stale 'pending' state in the new schema. Activating the trigger before the backfill ensures that all concurrent writes are correctly propagated to the new schema, maintaining consistency throughout the migration.

tool_output.description: Migrating orders.status (VARCHAR) to order_statuses (lookup table + status_id FK). An unsafe legacy payment trigger updates only status text while backfill is running.
